description:
Read the workspace agent org chart — departments, agents, who inherits from whom, and which agents are unplaced.

WHAT THE ORG CHART IS FOR: agents in a workspace each carry their own instructions, so shared standards get copy-pasted into every one and drift. Grouping agents under departments lets a standard be written ONCE on the department and inherited by every agent beneath it.

TWO EDGE KINDS:
- inherits_context_from — the ONE solid line. Passes the parent's context down. An agent has at most one.
- delegates_to — this agent may hand work to that one. Relationship only, NO context inherited.
- escalates_to — reach another AGENT when stuck. The department LEAD is the next rung up: a HUMAN, for when no agent can decide.

BOUNDARIES: a department may declare stopConditions (where agents beneath must stop and escalate rather than proceed) and a write scope. Stop conditions UNION down the chain — a descendant may add one, never remove one. Write scope INTERSECTS — a descendant may be more restricted, never less. Report these to the user when they ask what an agent is allowed to do.

Call this BEFORE proposing any reorganisation: you need to see every agent and existing group first. Returns unplacedAgentIds so you can see who still needs a home.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your active workspace.
